course.title: Mechanical Behavior of Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Determine the theoretical fracture strength of a silica fiber. If the modulus of elasticity is 95 (10) GPa, surface-creation energy is $1 . 5 ~ \mathrm { J } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$ and equilibrium atomic distance of two silica atoms is 0.15 nm. Also, calculate the practical fracture strength of the same material in the presence of a 150 nm length crack.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
